title: Recall: Transform and retain elements in place
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

retain.clue: Given values: Vec<i32> with a mutable binding, write a complete retain statement keeping strictly positive integers. Name the predicate parameter value and dereference it. Include the semicolon.

mutate.clue: Given mutable values: Vec<i32>, write a for loop over iter_mut using binding value and multiply each dereferenced integer by 2 with *=.
